name: Brick-based Volume Rendering with Overlap and LRU Swapping
aliases: Object Space Partitioning with Uniform Texture Bricks
definition: Dividing a volume into smaller 3D texture bricks to manage memory, improve data locality, and reduce bus transfer overhead by avoiding reloading void bricks.
summary: Brick-based volume rendering with overlap and LRU swapping manages large volumes by using small bricks, void detection, and LRU swapping to reduce bus transfer overhead.
